steps_items.heading: Verify Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of a secondary education requirement — no prior project management work experience needed. This accessibility makes CAPM ideal for Reno professionals entering the field across logistics, advanced manufacturing, data centers, and other growing sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your certification application, confirming your educational eligibility and paying the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the online submission process to ensure accuracy and timeliness.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study materials aligned to CAPM's knowledge domains. Schedule your proctored exam at a test center or online, and demonstrate your readiness to manage projects professionally.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education options to help you stay current and advance toward the PMP or other PMI credentials as your career evolves.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
